items.title: Laurena Diggs and Carrie Boote Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: Well, they lived in Mississippi. They had a brace band there, the Pickwick brace band, and it was two brothers, Joe Pruset and Eddie Pruset.

ctx.x: Well, who was this guy? Jill Pruset or Gil or something? Pruset? I couldn't understand it on the tape. Uh... I think he was... Joe Pruset? Oh, that must be Joe Pruset.

Well, they lived in Mississippi. They had a brace band there, the Pickwick brace band, and it was two brothers, Joe Pruset and Eddie Pruset. They had a brace band in Morris Point, Mississippi. They used to come over here and play. You know, the bands used to travel around during that time. And they would parade around the street then in wagons, you know. What was it? Trucks or wagons? I don't remember. And they would, like they're going to have a dance at the Bulls, well, they would play on each corner, you know,…
